title: A course's lessons with each learner's progress: how far they are, the next lesson to take, and the certificate at the end
about: An online course, a training plan, an onboarding path: the lessons in order, each with its number, length and whether this person has done it; a bar of how many are done; the next lesson as the one main action ('Start lesson 3'); and, once all are done, the certificate. A lesson done is a row of the progress table (one per person and lesson; declare its access ALLOW ALL ON <progress> TO members WHERE <person column> = :user_id so each learner sees their own). Someone not signed in sees the lessons and is asked to sign in to keep their progress.

progress.about: the table of lessons done: one row per person and lesson

lesson.about: the progress column holding the lesson's id

text.about: a column with a line about each lesson

minutes.about: a column with each lesson's length in minutes

order.about: SQL ORDER BY for the lessons

where.about: an SQL condition on the lessons (one course: course = :course)

params.about: values for :names in where, may be expressions such as "=params.course"

open.about: the view that shows one lesson, opened with {id}

certificate.about: the view that shows the certificate, opened once every lesson is done

needs.about: an SQL query that gives a row when the person may open the lessons (a paid enrolment: SELECT id FROM enrolments WHERE owner_id = :user_id AND status = 'paid'); left out, the lessons are open

locked.about: what a person who may not open them yet is told
locked.default: The lessons open once you are enrolled.

unlock.about: the view that unlocks them (enrolling, paying), opened from the locked note

unlockLabel.about: the label of the button to that view

{{key}}.sql: SELECT * FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }} ORDER BY {{order}} LIMIT 200

data.{{key}}_done: =app.me().then(m => m ? app.sql('SELECT {{lesson}} AS lesson FROM {{progress}} LIMIT 2000') : [])

props.label: =app.me() ? 'Your progress' : 'Sign in to keep your progress'
